evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: Aphoristic maxim pairing owned/rented as matched opposition — the document's register signature crystallized in one line, technical in vocabulary yet plain-spoken in delivery.

evidence.quote: the perspective is the asset you keep.

observations.why: Same maxim register: substrate/perspective/asset compressed into a declarative that names what persists — technical terms rendered plain-spoken.

Native pipeline vocabulary ('navigating extractor') signals the technical register, but the surrounding sentence is meta-commentary restating the thesis — a weaker, self-glossing instantiation of the same signature.

mints.name: AphoristicTechnicalMaxim
